desc: The Arisaka Offset Scout Mount holds a scout-style weapon light at a 45 degree angle, tucking it in closer to the handguard. Oriented upwards, the light sits at approximately the 1:30 or 10:30 clock position; oriented downwards, at approximately the 4:30 or 6:30 clock position. Each version is made for a specific handguard interface, so check the product title for the version that fits your rail.
